reponse:
The Postgres 17 production cutover is scheduled for **Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 02:00 to 05:00 UTC**, per the Linear ticket KES-398 (updated November 16) [2].

* **Contradiction with older docs:** The Notion runbook (October 28) [1] and the `#eng-announce` Slack post (November 3) [3] still show the original November 21 date, as the upgrade was postponed on November 12 [4] and the runbook has not been updated yet—KES-398 is the current reference [2].
* **Customer notice & impact:** The customer notice (status page and in-app banner) is scheduled to go out on **Saturday, November 28** [2]. During the maintenance window, dashboards will be read-only for about 40 minutes during the switch, while ingestion continues buffering in Kafka with no data loss [1].
